name: ellipsis
useCase: Open additional actions for the current item.
misuse: Name the menu action and its item; dots do not explain the action.

16.reason: The dots are deliberately sparse and centered on the horizontal axis; inflating them to match a closed contour would make them too assertive. Text master: 1.5px construction.

24.reason: The dots are deliberately sparse and centered on the horizontal axis; inflating them to match a closed contour would make them too assertive. Interface master: 1.75px construction.
